1247 PM CDT Mon Sep 14 2026

...FLOOD WATCH IN EFFECT FROM TUESDAY AFTERNOON THROUGH WEDNESDAY
AFTERNOON...

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...Portions of north central and northeast Kansas, including
  the following counties, Clay, Washington, Brown, Jackson,
  Jefferson, Marshall, Nemaha, Pottawatomie and Riley.

* WHEN...From Tuesday afternoon through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
  creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
  - Thunderstorms are forecast to have access to abundant moisture
    and could redevelop and move over the region multiple times. By
    Wednesday afternoon, some locations could end up with around 3
    inches of rain.


PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...

You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.
